name: 날렵한 망토
subject: One compact moss-green adventurer's cloak, a softly rounded hood/collar at the top and broad cloth billowing gently to the right, fast and light but still a substantial readable silhouette. The open front is suggested by one dark-green folded plane; one pale green shoulder/upper fold and a single small golden clasp. Bottom hem has two broad natural points, not many ragged thin strips. The cloak alone, without character, body, head or mannequin. Matte cloth, gentle rounded pixel stairs and just two useful folds; no embroidery, lining patterns, motion streaks or sparkles.

The integral loop is thick and its center opening is truly transparent, a clear four-logical-pixel-wide opening rather than a dark painted dot.
